items.name: Win11Debloat
items.description: A simple, lightweight PowerShell script that allows you to remove pre-installed apps, disable telemetry, as well as perform various other changes to declutter and customize your Windows experience. Win11Debloat works for both Windows 10 and Windows 11.

descriptions.zh: 一个简单、轻量级的 PowerShell 脚本，允许您删除预安装的应用程序、禁用遥测以及执行各种其他更改以整理和自定义您的 Windows 体验。 Win11Debloat 适用于 Windows 10 和 Windows 11。
descriptions.en: A simple, lightweight PowerShell script that allows you to remove pre-installed apps, disable telemetry, as well as perform various other changes to declutter and customize your Windows experience. Win11Debloat works for both Windows 10 and Windows 11.
